subject: Re: Demo + pricing — availability and next steps (CaffTech)

From: Alex Jordan <alex.jordan@cafftech.io>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-22T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Pricing + quick demo request

Hi team,

I signed up through your pricing page and selected the budget option (approx $150k/yr). We're evaluating inference platforms for a customer-facing retrieval + generation feature. Would like a short product walkthrough focused on throughput, latency, and hosting options (private VPC). Ideally next week — we are PT (San Francisco).

Key constraints: HIPAA-adjacent workflow, must support VPC, and predictable 99th-percentile latency < 250ms for conversational turns.

Can someone run a 30-min session + share pricing guidance?

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Jordan
Head of Platform
CaffTech

- Do you have an existing cloud region preference (AWS us-west-2 / GCP us-west1)?
- Is the HIPAA-adjacent requirement a hard block for hosted API, or are you looking at Private/Dedicated only?

- Tue 9/24 10:00–10:30
- Wed 9/25 14:00–14:30

Marissa (AE) will lead the demo and address pricing. I’ll send a calendar invite once you confirm a time. Also linking the HubSpot deal for your reference: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/98765
